arxiv-2112-06287.title: Identifying bias in cluster quality metrics
arxiv-2112-06287.creator: Martí Renedo-Mirambell, Argimiro Arratia
arxiv-2112-06287.description: Abstract We study potential biases of popular cluster quality metrics, such as conductance or modularity. We propose a method that uses both stochastic and preferential attachment block models construction to generate networks with preset community structures, to which quality metrics will be applied.

arxiv-2204-13063.title: Semi-discrete Lagrangian 2-forms and the Toda hierarchy
arxiv-2204-13063.creator: Duncan Sleigh, Mats Vermeeren
arxiv-2204-13063.description: Abstract We present a variational theory of integrable differential-difference equations (semi-discrete integrable systems). This is an extension of the ideas known by the names “Lagrangian multiforms” and “Pluri-Lagrangian systems”, which have previously been established in both the fully discrete and fully continuous cases.

arxiv-2311-09045.title: On a conjecture of Feigin, Wang and Yoshinaga
arxiv-2311-09045.creator: Hiraku Kawanoue
arxiv-2311-09045.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hiraku Kawanoue. We settled a conjecture of Feigin, Wang and Yoshinaga, appeared in the preprint “Integral expressions for derivations of multiarrangements”. This is a short report about a conjecture of Feigin, Wang and Yoshinaga in [ 1 ] . In the preprint [ 1 ] , Feigin, Wang and Yoshinaga constructed a candidate of basis for the module of logarithmic vector fields of the extended Catalan arrangement \operatorname{Cat}(B_{2},m) of type B_{2} in the following way. First they define {f_{i}^{m}}(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x}t^{2i}(t^{2}-x^{2})^{m}(t^{2}-y^{2})^{m}\,dt\qquad(i,m\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}).

arxiv-2402-02674.title: Modeling X-ray and gamma-ray emission from redback pulsar binaries Facilities: CXO, XMM-Newton, NuSTAR HEAsoft ( NASA High Energy Astrophysics Science Archive Research Center (2014) Heasarc , v6.31.1;) , CIAO ( CIAO Development Team 2013 , v4.12;) , XMM-SAS ( SAS development team 2014 , 20230412_173
arxiv-2402-02674.creator: Minju Sim, Hongjun An, Zorawar Wadiasingh
arxiv-2402-02674.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Minju Sim, Hongjun An, Zorawar Wadiasingh. We investigated the multiband emission from the pulsar binaries XSS J12270 − - 4859, PSR J2039 − - 5617, and PSR J2339 − - 0533, which exhibit orbital modulation in the X-ray and gamma-ray bands. We constructed the sources’ broadband spectral energy distributions and multiband orbital light curves by supplementing our X-ray measurements with published gamma-ray results, and we modeled the data using intra-binary shock (IBS) scenarios.

arxiv-2402-10109.title: Towards Reducing Diagnostic Errors with Interpretable Risk Prediction
arxiv-2402-10109.creator: Denis Jered McInerney, William Dickinson, Lucy C. Flynn, Andrea C. Young, Geoffrey S. Young, Jan-Willem van de Meent, Byron C. Wallace
arxiv-2402-10109.description: Abstract Many diagnostic errors occur because clinicians cannot easily access relevant information in patient Electronic Health Records (EHRs). In this work we propose a method to use LLMs to identify pieces of evidence in patient EHR data that indicate increased or decreased risk of specific diagnoses; our ultimate aim is to increase access to evidence and reduce diagnostic errors.

arxiv-2406-12473.title: Underwater Human-Robot and Human-Swarm Interaction: A Review and Perspective
arxiv-2406-12473.creator: Sara Aldhaheri, Federico Renda, Giulia De Masi
arxiv-2406-12473.description: Abstract There has been a growing interest in extending the capabilities of autonomous underwater vehicles in subsea missions, particularly in integrating underwater human-robot interaction for control. Underwater human-robot interaction and its subfield, underwater gesture recognition, play a significant role in enhancing diver-robot communication for marine research.

arxiv-2406-15087.title: Model Checking Markov Chains as Distribution Transformers
arxiv-2406-15087.creator: Rajab Aghamov, Christel Baier, Toghrul Karimov, Joris Nieuwveld, Joël Ouaknine, Jakob Piribauer, Mihir Vahanwala
arxiv-2406-15087.description: Abstract The conventional perspective on Markov chains considers decision problems concerning the probabilities of temporal properties being satisfied by traces of visited states. However, consider the following query made of a stochastic system modelling the weather: given the conditions today, will there be a day with less than 50% chance of rain?

arxiv-2503-10664.title: Semantic Wave Functions: Exploring Meaning in Large Language Models Through Quantum Formalism
arxiv-2503-10664.creator: Timo Aukusti Laine
arxiv-2503-10664.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) encode semantic relationships in high-dimensional vector embeddings. This paper explores the analogy between LLM embedding spaces and quantum mechanics, positing that LLMs operate within a quantized semantic space where words and phrases behave as quantum states.

arxiv-2503-18826.title: Interpretable and Fair Mechanisms for Abstaining Classifiers
arxiv-2503-18826.creator: Daphne Lenders, Andrea Pugnana, Roberto Pellungrini, Toon Calders, Dino Pedreschi, Fosca Giannotti
arxiv-2503-18826.description: Abstract Abstaining classifiers have the option to refrain from providing a prediction for instances that are difficult to classify. The abstention mechanism is designed to trade off the classifier’s performance on the accepted data while ensuring a minimum number of predictions.

pmc-10494341.title: Metabolomic profiling of Wilson disease, an inherited disorder of copper metabolism, and diseases with similar symptoms but normal copper metabolism
pmc-10494341.creator: Yijie Qiu, Mingchuan Su, Xina Xiao, Dingzi Zhou, Linshen Xie
pmc-10494341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundWilson’s disease (WD) is a hereditary disorder that results in the accumulation of copper. The pathogenic mechanism is not well understood, and diagnosing the disease can be challenging, as it shares similarities with more prevalent conditions. To explore the metabolomic features of WD and differentiate it from other diseases related to copper metabolism, we conducted targeted and untargeted metabolomic profiling using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS).

pmc-12418798.title: Clinical value of preoperative serum calcium level in predicting deep infiltrative endometriosis among ovarian endometrioma
pmc-12418798.creator: Huiyun Jiang, Yingxiang Wang, Jie Ding, Yu Zhang
pmc-12418798.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate preoperative serum calcium levels and their association with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE) in ovarian endometrioma.DesignA retrospective, observational cohort study.ParticipantsA total of 2,557 women who underwent surgery for benign ovarian tumors were initially enrolled. Of these, 987 were pathologically confirmed to have endometriosis, while the remaining 1570 did not.

pmc-12618345.title: The Global Patient Perspective on Uncontrolled Moderate-to-Severe Asthma: Reducing Delays in Diagnosis and Treatment
pmc-12618345.creator: Karen Rance, Brenda Young, Gretchen McCreary, Stephanie Williams, Marilyn Urrutia-Pereira, Kristen Willard, Ghulam Mustafa, Purvi Parikh, Tonya Winders, Ruth Tal-Singer
pmc-12618345.description: IntroductionUncontrolled asthma greatly affects quality of life globally and highlights unmet medical needs. Despite advances in treatment and care, many patients still experience delayed diagnoses, poor symptom control, and a reliance on emergency care. The Global Allergy and Airways Patient Platform (GAAPP) surveyed patients with moderate-to-severe uncontrolled asthma to assess their care experiences.

pmc-12730591.title: Balancing Bleeding and Clot: Type 2 Heparin-Induced Thrombocytopenia With Extensive Thromboses in a Patient With Subdural Hematoma
pmc-12730591.creator: George K Annan, Enoch Enninful, Chinenye Egwuonwu, Stanley E Atencah, Patrick O Berchie
pmc-12730591.description: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) type 2 is a rare, immune-mediated complication of heparin therapy characterized by thrombocytopenia and paradoxical thrombosis. It results from platelet-activating antibodies against platelet factor 4 (PF4)/heparin complexes and can precipitate life-threatening thromboembolic events. Management becomes especially challenging in patients with concurrent bleeding, such as intracranial hemorrhage, where anticoagulation carries significant risk.

pmc-12964390.title: CSF Proteomic Profiles Associated With White Matter Integrity in Cognitively Normal Older Adults With and Without Amyloid Pathology
pmc-12964390.creator: Luigi Lorenzini, Mario Tranfa, Mara Ten Kate, Anouk den Braber, Lisa Vermunt, Flora H. Duits, Senne B. Lageman, Diederick de Leeuw, Charlotte E. Teunissen, Sara Garbarino, Luca Roccatagliata, Matteo Pardini, Wiesje M. Van Der Flier, Pieter Jelle Visser, Frederik Barkhof, Betty M. Tijms
pmc-12964390.description: Background and ObjectivesIncreasing evidence indicates a potential role of white matter (WM) damage in the onset and progression of Alzheimer disease (AD). However, the biological processes underlying in vivo WM imaging biomarkers remain unclear. We sought to determine the molecular signatures associated with WM integrity in cognitively normal individuals with and without amyloid pathology.

pmc-13010261.title: Genome Mining-Driven Isolation of New Gromomycins and Insights into Their Mode of Action
pmc-13010261.creator: Dmytro Bratiichuk, Franziska Fries, Marc Stierhof, Leon Morguet, Josef Zapp, Mathias Müsken, Yuriy Rebets, Maksym Myronovskyi, Rolf Müller, Jennifer Herrmann, Andriy Luzhetskyy
pmc-13010261.description: The growing threat of multidrug-resistant bacterial infections highlights the urgent need for antibiotics with novel mechanisms of action. Gromomycins, a newly identified class of triterpene antibiotics, exhibit potent activity against Gram-positive bacteria, including drug-resistant species, through a previously uncharacterized mode of action.

pmc-13103613.title: Reverse Hierarchical Processing of Speech in Talker Identification
pmc-13103613.creator: Ja Young Choi, Shengyue Xiong, Jacie R McHaney, Bharath Chandrasekaran
pmc-13103613.description: Spoken language contains critical information related to “what” is being said as well as “who” is talking. Listeners use various cues from speech to identify talkers. Talkers can be identified primarily based on acoustic cues, but access to higher‐level cues depends on the extent of language familiarity.

pmc-13191834.title: A life course perspective on evolving hypertension and diabetes risk among older Indians
pmc-13191834.creator: Aditi Chakraborty, Suryakant Yadav
pmc-13191834.description: PurposeThe growing burden of non-communicable diseases in ageing populations demands urgent public health attention. Hypertension and diabetes, as chronic conditions, frequently co-exist and pose serious public health challenges due to their contribution to cardiovascular morbidity, premature mortality and escalating healthcare costs.

pmc-13389464.title: Fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma oncofusions share a common interactome
pmc-13389464.creator: S. P. Zimmerman, C. D. Delaney, B. K. Lau, L. B. DeGraw, G. H. Rupprecht, M. J. A. Groot Koerkamp, T. de Souza, J. Drost, R. A. Schoot, M. T. Meister, J. F. Shern, L. M. Wagner, G. G. Wang, K. C. Wood, C. M. Linardic, C. M. Counter
pmc-13389464.description: Fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma (FP-RMS) arises from at least seven distinct oncofusions sharing a common PAX3/7 N-terminal DNA-binding domain fused to divergent C-terminal partners. How different oncofusions produce the same cancer was unknown. Here we show they are functionally interchangeable, associate with a shared protein network we term the common interactome, bind overlapping target genes, and drive a similar core transcriptional program.

uslaw-usc-t54-s308402.title: 54 U.S.C. § 308402 — African American Civil Rights Network
uslaw-usc-t54-s308402.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s308402.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3084 (African American Civil Rights Network). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— The Secretary shall establish, within the Service, a program to be known as the “African American Civil Rights Network”. (b) Duties of Secretary.— In carrying out the Network, the Secretary shall— (1) review studies and reports.
